name: Cubing at The Game Expo 2024

venue.name: [Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre](https://www.mcec.com.au/)
venue.address: Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Country, 1 Convention Centre Pl, South Wharf VIC 3006

information: # IMPORTANT INFORMATION This competition takes place at **The Game Expo** in the Melbourne Convention & Exhibition Centre. In order to compete at this competition, you are **required** to purchase a ticket for the expo. Tickets can be purchased [here](https://www.tixr.com/groups/thegameexpo/events/the-game-expo-2024-82764) (only a Saturday pass is required). Your registration will only be approved once we verify you have purchased a ticket for The Game Expo on Saturday. Verification can be done by emailing the delegates for this competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2RrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f3c65f6badcaf2cf88a5906c23981d94f2958296/image.png) ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au) Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Wurundjeri people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.
